holly.def: Any of various shrubs or small trees, of the genus Ilex, either evergreen or deciduous, used as decoration especially at Christmas

bishop.def: An overseer of congregations: either any such overseer, generally speaking, or an official in the church hierarchy governing a diocese, supervising the church's priests, deacons, and property in its territory

salad.def: A food consisting principally of raw vegetables, other savoury ingredients, fruit, or confectionary; often involving two or more such ingredients mixed together, with larger items cut or torn into small pieces, and usually with a dressing or binding; usually served cold or at room temperature, as a dish or savoury sandwich filling

link.def: A connection between places, people, events, things, or ideas

underground.def: Below the ground; below the surface of the Earth

miller.def: A person who owns or operates a mill, especially a flourmill

smiling.def: That smiles or has a smile

brick.def: A hardened rectangular block of mud, clay etc., used for building

presents.def: The contents of the present document: the one in which the word presents appears

chip.def: A small piece broken from a larger piece of solid material

western.def: Of, facing, situated in, or related to the west

surveillance.def: Close observation of an individual or group; person or persons under suspicion

uses.def: A form of equitable ownership peculiar to English law, by which one person enjoys the profits of lands, etc. whose legal title is vested in another in trust

booth.def: A small stall for the display and sale of goods

brad.def: A thin, small nail, with a slight projection at the top on one side instead of a head, or occasionally with a small domed head, similar to that of an escutcheon pin

average.def: Any measure of central tendency, especially any mean, the median, or the mode

deputy.def: One appointed as the substitute of others, and empowered to act for them, in their name or their behalf; a substitute in office

headquarters.def: The military installation from which troops are commanded and orders are issued; the military unit consisting of a commander and his support staff

moral.def: Of or relating to principles of right and wrong in behaviour, especially conforming to principles of rectitude

surgeon.def: One who performs surgery; a doctor who performs operations on people or animals

chill.def: A moderate, but uncomfortable and penetrating coldness

bug.def: An insect of the order Hemiptera

anniversary.def: A day that is an exact number of years since a given significant event occurred. Often preceded by an ordinal number indicating the number of years

stake.def: A piece of wood or other material, usually long and slender, pointed at one end so as to be easily driven into the ground as a marker or a support or stay

doorbell.def: A bell, buzzer, or chime device mounted on or adjacent to a door's exterior, meant to be rung by a visitor to announce one's presence

ward.def: A warden; a guard; a guardian or watchman

ease.def: Lack of difficulty; the ability to do something easily

fee.def: An amount charged in return for permission to do something

woo.def: To endeavor to gain someone's affection or support

principle.def: A fundamental assumption, fundamental law or guiding belief

loaded.def: Burdened by some heavy load; packed

abuse.def: Improper treatment or usage; application to a wrong or bad purpose; an unjust, corrupt or wrongful practice or custom

appeal.def: An application to a superior court or judge for a decision or order by an inferior court or judge to be reviewed and overturned

digging.def: The action performed by a person or thing that digs

awkward.def: Lacking dexterity in the use of the hands or of tools

visiting.def: The act of someone or something that visits

pat.def: The sound of a light slap or tap with a soft flat object, especially of a footstep

answering.def: The act of giving an answer

nancy.def: An effeminate man, especially a homosexual

sport.def: Any activity that uses physical exertion or skills competitively under a set of rules that is not based on aesthetics

electric.def: Of, relating to, produced by, operated with, or utilising electricity; electrical

nail.def: The horny plate or appendage at the ends of the digits of various animals, including most reptiles, birds, and mammals

pirate.def: A criminal who plunders at sea; commonly attacking merchant vessels, though often pillaging port towns

beth.def: The second letter of the Phoenician alphabet, 𐤁

forth.def: Forward in time, place or degree

gray.def: Of a color between black and white, having neutral hue and intermediate brightness

homicide.def: The killing of one person by another, whether premeditated or unintentional

album.def: In Ancient Rome, a white tablet or register on which the praetor's edicts and other public notices were recorded

fingerprint.def: The natural pattern of ridges on the tips of human fingers, unique to each individual

survivor.def: One who survives, especially one who survives a traumatic experience
